name: document-svg
description: Convert 60+ document, diagram, CAD, 3D, mesh, chart, geospatial, math, and data formats to SVG pages, transform SVG, and package SVG into Office, draw.io, HTML, or WebP.

interface.shortDescription: Convert between documents, data, diagrams and SVG pages.
interface.longDescription: Converts 60+ document, diagram, CAD, 3D, mesh, chart, geospatial, math, and data formats into deterministic per-page SVG files, transforms SVG files, and packages SVG pages back into PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, draw.io, HTML viewer, or WebP.
defaultPrompt: Convert this PDF or Office document into SVG pages and check the warnings.
Create SVG previews for this presentation.
Package these SVG pages back into a PowerPoint file.
